Lena (CSM): Kicking off NimbleCare onboarding. Quick 15m sync to lock owners, 30d acceptance criteria, and 3 renewal signals. Proposed Tue 10:30 PT. Agenda: owners, data pre-reqs, success metrics.
Sam (NimbleCare PO): Tue 10:30 PT works. Legal wants a short item on retention and PHI masking. Also want a simple cost estimate for our primary flow.
Ibrahim (Solutions Eng): For integration I need a sanitized sample CSV and expected peak qps. If peak >30 qps we'll discuss reserved capacity. Sample staging auth I use will be a one-liner once keys are up: `export RW_API_KEY=stg-nc-XXX` then a quick curl smoke test.
Jules (Enablement): I'll run a 20-min follow-up demo + runbook (10-min demo, 10-min runbook). Will include masking verification steps and a checklist for audit logs. I'll record and upload KB.
Lena (CSM): Draft 30d acceptance criteria to confirm:
- Staging ingest + two P0 flows validated end-to-end
- Recorded demo + runbook delivered to NimbleCare team
- Dashboard with 3 renewal signals: core flow usage, ingest error rate, time-to-first-successful-inference
Risks: delayed sanitized data, retention signoff lag, quota surprises. We'll assign mitigations in the meeting.
Sam (NimbleCare PO): We'll provide sanitized CSV & retention policy Mon EOD. For cost estimate, can you ballpark token/unit costs after you see sample payloads?
Lena (CSM): Yes 11 once Ibrahim shares cost calc based on sample. I'll also include the early-value signals in our weekly health email for renewal monitoring.
OnboardingBot: Calendar event created: "NimbleCare onboarding intake" Tue 10:30 PT. Invitees: Lena, Sam, Ibrahim, Jules.
Lena (CSM): I'll post a 1-pager with pre-reqs 2 hours before the call. See you Tue :white_check_mark:
